problem: Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the lines $y=-x,$ $y=2$ and $y=\frac{x}{2}.$ Express ${∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type I regions.

feedback.problem: Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curve $y=\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+2,$ and the lines $y=x+2,$ $x=-2$ and $x=2.$ Express ${∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type I regions.
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's sketch our region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/019f0f9f83ddf323d543d109677335cb3ae72a200baf834453a0eca16a9353ba.png)

The region $D$ can be partitioned into two type I regions ${D}_{1}$ and ${D}_{2},$ as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/d222e86f6af7c3ed2b35711114c9062d6f0c9b0f2551aa44cac33318c6e5813f.png)

As a result, we get

$$
{D}_{1}={(x,y)\,:\,-2\le x\le 0,\,x+2\le y\le \frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+2}
$$

and 

$$
{D}_{2}={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 2,\,\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+2\le y\le x+2}.
$$

Therefore, using the additivity property of double integrals, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA & ={∬}_{{D}_{1}}f(x,y)\,dA+{∬}_{{D}_{2}}f(x,y)\,dA \\  & ={\int }_{-2}^{0}{\int }_{x+2}^{{x}^{2}/2+2}f(x,y)\,dy\,dx+{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{{x}^{2}/2+2}^{x+2}f(x,y)\,dy\,dx.\end{aligned}
$$
